Overview

Cagliari is a city in Sardinia with a population of 149,000. Sardinia’s vibrant capital, with a stunning medieval quarter, white sand beaches nearby, and a unique island culture all its own. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
